briefdescription.para: LLM Module — API Contract Hardening focused regression tests.

detaileddescription.para: Covers the normative contracts defined in include/llm/llm_api_contract.h across four acceptance-criteria tracks:

listitem.para: LAC-01..04 — Inference contract (null model, empty input, cancel pre-inference)
LAC-05..08 — Batch consistency (order preserved, partial batch, max batch size)
LAC-09..12 — Stream contract (callback invoked, exception swallowed, cancel mid-stream)
LAC-13..16 — Plugin lifecycle (RAII load/unload, double-unload safe, null plugin)
LAC-17..20 — Embed contract (L2 norm ≈ 1.0, empty string, batch consistent with single)

detaileddescription.para: All infrastructure is fully in-process; no real model files are required. Deterministic test data is seeded with kLlmContractSeed = 42.
